name: Tibalt
description: Tibalt is a devil planeswalker, born human on Innistrad and transformed into a half-devil, who sows war and chaos.

description_citations.text: "Tibalt". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.
"Episode 2: Awaken the Trolls" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2021.

summary.text: Tibalt is a devil planeswalker, born human on Innistrad and transformed into a half-devil, who sows war and chaos.

citations.text: "Tibalt". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.
"Episode 2: Awaken the Trolls" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2021.

bio.text: Tibalt was born human on Innistrad and explored fiendish magic out of fascination with pain until he was transformed into a half-devil.

citations.text: "Tibalt". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: On Kaldheim he posed as Valki, the God of Lies, urging the troll clans to attack first and ordering his trolls to kill Kaya.

citations.text: "Episode 2: Awaken the Trolls" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2021.
"Episode 2: Awaken the Trolls" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2021.

bio.text: He tricked and imprisoned Valki, convinced King Harald that the elves must strike first, and used the Sword of the Realms to unleash Koma on the Valkyries.

citations.text: "Episode 3: The Saga of Tibalt" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2021.
"Episode 3: The Saga of Tibalt" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2021.

bio.text: He told Kaya that he had already started the Doomskar, then fought her and Tyvar before dissolving into cinders and planeswalking away.

citations.text: "Episode 4: Into the Demons' Realm" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2021.
"Episode 4: Into the Demons' Realm" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2021.

bio.text: He later served Phyrexia as a compleated devil with twin barbed tails who spread doubt.

citations.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 4: Impossible Odds" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Failing as an apprentice Skaberen, Tibalt isolates himself and experiments on living creatures' limits of pain, eventually using people.
timeline.quote: eventually, he moved on to people

citation.text: "Tibalt", section "Ascension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Devils gather at Tibalt's laboratory and teach him the nature of pain.
timeline.quote: they sought to assist him, offering Tibalt insights into his obsession, the very nature of pain

citation.text: "Tibalt", section "Ascension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Caught by inquisitors, Tibalt fuses his essence with the devils; the trauma ignites his spark and he is flung across the Blind Eternities.
timeline.quote: The shock and trauma ignited Tibalt's spark

citation.text: "Tibalt", section "Ascension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tibalt decides to interfere with Sorin Markov on Innistrad to torment him.
timeline.quote: Tibalt decided that he had to interfere

citation.text: "Tibalt", section "Tibalt vs. Sorin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin returns to find Avacyn gone and Innistrad in chaos; he deals with Tibalt.
timeline.quote: Tibalt posed a significant threat if left unchecked

citation.text: "Sorin Markov", section "Fall of Thraben". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tibalt intruded into Pia's home and tortured her to feed on Chandra's agony.
timeline.quote: The planeswalker Tibalt intruded into Pia's home and tortured her as a way to feed on Chandra's agony.

citation.text: "Pia Nalaar", section "In Tibalt's clutches". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret flees to Esper and learns from Tibalt that Bolas is dead.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret fled to Esper on Alara

citation.text: "Tezzeret", section "Forsaken". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tibalt is lured to Ravnica and trapped; he fights the Eternals while tormenting civilians and leads demons and devils with Davriel Cane.
timeline.quote: He led an army of demons and devils alongside the diabolist Davriel Cane .

citation.text: "Tibalt", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chandra finds peace with herself and knocks out Tibalt, delivering him to the authorities on Innistrad.
timeline.quote: she knocked him out and delivered him to the local authorities to deal with

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "Aftermath of the War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the War of the Spark Tibalt confronts Chandra on Zendikar and drives her to planeswalk away.
timeline.quote: he unleashed an attack on Chandra that caused her to planeswalk away from Zendikar

citation.text: "Tibalt", section "Plaguing Chandra". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tibalt tortures Chandra's mother on Kaladesh, then is overwhelmed and knocked out by Chandra and locked in a rune-enforced prison.
timeline.quote: She knocked him out and delivered him to the local authorities to deal with.

citation.text: "Tibalt", section "Plaguing Chandra". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaya finds a crowd of trolls and a hooded man on a stone block calling himself Valki, the God of Lies.
timeline.quote: All know me as Valki, and my first gift to you, the gift of languages, is free.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Awaken the Trolls" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Tibalt, as Valki, urges the troll clans to attack first against invaders from other worlds.
timeline.quote: the clans of the Gnottvold must attack first!

citation.text: "Episode 2: Awaken the Trolls" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaya blows away Valki's illusion, revealing the devil planeswalker Tibalt.
timeline.quote: in place of the God of Lies stood a red-skinned man with two prominent horns

citation.text: "Episode 2: Awaken the Trolls" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Tibalt orders his trolls to kill Kaya; she incapacitates two with phasing, and the others flee.
timeline.quote: The second jabbed at her with a rusty, ancient-looking sword.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Awaken the Trolls" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaya chases Tibalt and corners him; he says chaos is its own reward and denies knowledge of the monster.
timeline.quote: Chaos is its own reward, and nothing puts a smile on my face like a bit of mayhem.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Awaken the Trolls" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Tibalt whistles and wakes six Torga trolls from beneath the hills.
timeline.quote: One after another, they pulled free of the earth, showering the clearing with clumps of black dirt.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Awaken the Trolls" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Tibalt opens a portal to a fiery realm with a glass sword and leaves Kaya with the trolls.
timeline.quote: With that, he stepped through the portal.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Awaken the Trolls" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Tyvar says Tibalt visited his brother Harald and the elves are now preparing to march against the gods.
timeline.quote: ever since that visit the elves have been preparing for war

citation.text: "Episode 2: Awaken the Trolls" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Tibalt, narrating, boasts that his plotting will set Kaldheim ablaze, and tells the saga of a planeswalker named Tibalt.
timeline.quote: all of Kaldheim would be improved with a touch more fire, a dash of anarchy

citation.text: "Episode 3: The Saga of Tibalt" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: The Horrible Beast poisons Tibalt with a seed and forces him to cause a distraction, though Tibalt had already planned to stir up trouble.
timeline.quote: the Horrible Beast snuck up on him one day and stuck Tibalt with a nasty, tricky sort of poison

citation.text: "Episode 3: The Saga of Tibalt" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Tibalt tricks Valki, the God of Lies, to use him as a disguise.
timeline.quote: It happened that this God of Lies, this Prince of Tricksters, was foolish enough to get lied to and tricked himself.

citation.text: "Episode 3: The Saga of Tibalt" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Tibalt chains Valki and imprisons him in King Narfi's glacial palace in Karfell, striking a deal with Narfi.
timeline.quote: So long as Valki stayed deep in the dungeon of this King Narfi's glacial palace

citation.text: "Episode 3: The Saga of Tibalt" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Disguised as Valki, Tibalt visits Koll the Forgemaster, who refuses to hand over the Sword of the Realms, and pushes him into his forge.
timeline.quote: so Tibalt did the realms a favor and pushed the obnoxious dwarf right into his own forge

citation.text: "Episode 3: The Saga of Tibalt" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Tibalt, as Valki, convinces King Harald of Skemfar that the gods plan terrible things and that the elves must strike first.
timeline.quote: The only choice, if the elves were to survive, was clear: strike first.

citation.text: "Episode 3: The Saga of Tibalt" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Tibalt stirs trouble in Surtland and Bretagard, warning frost giants of trolls and promising the Skelle the return of Varragoth.
timeline.quote: Tibalt sowed the seeds of war and chaos

citation.text: "Episode 3: The Saga of Tibalt" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: With the Sword of the Realms, Tibalt cuts open a doorway to Starnheim and unleashes Koma on the Valkyries.
timeline.quote: he cut open a doorway to the home of the Valkyries, where the Cosmos Serpent could make up for lost time

citation.text: "Episode 3: The Saga of Tibalt" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Tibalt leaves a trail with the sword through Immersturm so a planeswalker will follow.
timeline.quote: he was leaving a trail, dragging the tip through the black basalt surface of Immersturm

citation.text: "Episode 3: The Saga of Tibalt" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Tibalt foretells that he will kill the planeswalker and Kaldheim will burn.
timeline.quote: Tibalt kills the planeswalker.

citation.text: "Episode 3: The Saga of Tibalt" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Tyvar explains the gods sealed the realm long ago and that Tibalt must have damaged the wards.
timeline.quote: But Tibalt must have somehow damaged the wards.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Into the Demons' Realm" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaya realizes Tibalt's sword opens portals and means to start a Doomskar; Tibalt answers that he already has.
timeline.quote: Kid, he's going to start a Doomskar!

citation.text: "Episode 4: Into the Demons' Realm" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Tibalt attacks from above with flame, and Kaya charges at him and hurls an axe.
timeline.quote: It clipped his shoulder, sent him sprawling

citation.text: "Episode 4: Into the Demons' Realm" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Tibalt breathes out a torrent of burning smoke that fills Kaya's mind with despair and doubt.
timeline.quote: The smoke poured from his mouth in a great and sudden torrent

citation.text: "Episode 4: Into the Demons' Realm" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Tyvar, immune to the doubt magic, blocks Tibalt's killing blow and introduces himself.
timeline.quote: He'd caught that shimmering god-light sword on the dagger fixed to his bracer.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Into the Demons' Realm" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Tyvar flips Tibalt over his shoulder and holds a blade to his neck.
timeline.quote: Tyvar grabbed him by his collar and flipped him over one shoulder

citation.text: "Episode 4: Into the Demons' Realm" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Tibalt tells them to go see for himself, then dissolves into cinders and planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: Like burning paper, his body dissolved into a mass of orange cinders

citation.text: "Episode 4: Into the Demons' Realm" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaya and Tyvar fail to stop Tibalt from creating a Doomskar, and thousands of demons led by Varragoth attack another realm.
timeline.quote: thousands of demons streamed through a giant rift in space to attack another realm

citation.text: "Immersturm", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaya exposes Tibalt behind the troll gathering and escapes with Tyvar's help.
timeline.quote: She quickly saw through the disguise and revealed the planeswalker Tibalt doing his dirty work

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tibalt creates a Doomskar before Kaya and Tyvar can take the Sword of the Realms from him.
timeline.quote: they were unable to prevent Tibalt from creating a Doomskar before they managed to take the sword from him

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the chaos instigated by Tibalt, Koma attacks Starnheim and Niko joins the valkyries in its defense.
timeline.quote: Starnheim was attacked by the the Cosmos serpent Koma and Niko joined a host of valkyries in defense of the realm.

citation.text: "Starnheim", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vorinclex ambushes Tibalt, infects him with phyresis and holds him hostage.
timeline.quote: Tibalt was ambushed by Vorinclex , who infected him with phyresis

citation.text: "Tibalt", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tibalt imprisons Valki in Karfell and assumes his identity, spreading chaos across the realms.
timeline.quote: Tibalt deceived the god Valki and imprisoned him in magical chains

citation.text: "Tibalt", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tibalt, using the Sword, opens an Omenpath for Koma in Starnheim and escapes Tyvar and Kaya to Immersturm.
timeline.quote: Using the Sword, Tibalt escaped both his enemies into the realm of Immersturm .

citation.text: "Tibalt", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tibalt creates a Doomskar before losing the Sword, and demons led by Varragoth attack another realm.
timeline.quote: Led by Varragoth, thousands of demons streamed through a giant rift in space to attack another realm.

citation.text: "Tibalt", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tibalt, disguised as Valki, advises King Harald to prepare for war; Tyvar grows suspicious and investigates.
timeline.quote: Suspicious of this "Valki", Tyvar began to follow and investigate the god through the realms.

citation.text: "Tyvar Kell", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tibalt creates a Doomskar and thousands of demons led by Varragoth stream through a rift to attack another realm.
timeline.quote: they were unable to prevent Tibalt from creating a Doomskar

citation.text: "Tyvar Kell", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vorinclex infects Tibalt, forcing him to cause a distraction in exchange for an antidote.
timeline.quote: he ambushed the planeswalker Tibalt and infected him

citation.text: "Vorinclex", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Davriel leads an army of demons and devils alongside Tibalt against the Dreadhorde.
timeline.quote: He led an army of demons and devils alongside the half- devil Tibalt .

citation.text: "Davriel Cane", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Compleated Ajani and Tibalt approach on the bridge, with Ajani urging Elspeth to join Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: came Ajani and Tibalt, but not as they had known them.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 4: Impossible Odds
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 4: Impossible Odds" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Tyvar confronts Tibalt and tells Kaito to take the others on to the root source.
timeline.quote: Elspeth and I will handle the vermin.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 4: Impossible Odds
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 4: Impossible Odds" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Kaito, Kaya and Jace leave, and Elspeth and Tyvar begin their battle against Ajani and Tibalt.
timeline.quote: and the battle was joined.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 4: Impossible Odds
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 4: Impossible Odds" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Tibalt taunts Tyvar as they fight with Tibalt's twin barbed tails.
timeline.quote: How does it feel to be the last prince of Kaldheim?

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Tibalt's doubt overwhelms Elspeth, who is disarmed by Ajani and backs away.
timeline.quote: Ajani's next blow knocked the weapon from her hands

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Elspeth's will returns, she blocks Ajani's blow, and Tyvar's magic suppresses Tibalt and the doubt he spreads.
timeline.quote: Your doubt can't touch what it can't reach.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Tyvar kills Tibalt by driving his own tail barbs through his chest and throwing him from the bridge, as Elspeth runs to find the others.
timeline.quote: Tyvar driving the twin barbs of Tibalt's tail into the space that should have held the Phyrexian's heart.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Vorinclex infects Tibalt with a seed.
timeline.quote: Vorinclex also infected Tibalt with a "seed", wounded the god Esika

citation.text: "New Phyrexia (plane)", section "Forays to other planes". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tyvar kills Tibalt by stabbing him through the chest while Elspeth fights Ajani.
timeline.quote: ultimately claiming victory by stabbing him through his chest cavity with his barbed tails

citation.text: "Tyvar Kell", section "Against New Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tibalt, born human on Innistrad, explores fiendish magic out of fascination with pain and is transformed into a half-devil.
timeline.quote: his fascination with pain drove him to explore fiendish magic that ultimately transformed him into a half-devil.

citation.text: "Tibalt". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

relations.note: The beast poisoned Tibalt to force him to help.
relations.quote: stuck Tibalt with a nasty, tricky sort of poison

citation.text: "Episode 3: The Saga of Tibalt" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2021.

relations.note: She wants to take his sword from him and fights him.
relations.quote: We've got to get that sword away from him

citation.text: "Episode 4: Into the Demons' Realm" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2021.

relations.note: Tyvar disarms him and demands to know what he has done.
relations.quote: Now, fiend, you will tell us what you've done.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Into the Demons' Realm" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2021.

relations.note: drove Tibalt's own tail barbs into his chest

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

citation.text: "Davriel Cane", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: killed in the rematch on New Phyrexia
relations.quote: Tyvar engaged Tibalt in a rematch

citation.text: "Tyvar Kell", section "Against New Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: A red-skinned, horned devil planeswalker who disguises himself as the god Valki to stir the Hagi trolls to war and wakes Torga trolls to kill Kaya.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Awaken the Trolls" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2021.

pages_say.description: A devil planeswalker who narrates the saga in third person, boasting that he is sowing war across Kaldheim and has lured a planeswalker (Kaya) to Immersturm.

citation.text: "Episode 3: The Saga of Tibalt" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2021.

pages_say.description: A horned, flame-wielding planeswalker who carves open the realm of the demons with a glass sword and starts the Doomskar, then escapes by planeswalking.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Into the Demons' Realm" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2021.

pages_say.description: Planeswalker whose treachery set off the Doomskar and a lie that sent the elves to war.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

pages_say.description: A devil planeswalker, now a nightmare of bony plates and a split tail, who serves Phyrexia.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 4: Impossible Odds
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 4: Impossible Odds" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

pages_say.description: A devil planeswalker, compleated, with twin barbed tails who spreads doubt and is killed by Tyvar.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 5: Inevitable Resolutions" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

pages_say.description: Revealed as the source of the conflict, aligned with New Phyrexia.

citation.text: "Battle for Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: A half-devil Planeswalker who fed on Chandra's agony.

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: A half-devil who fought alongside Davriel in the War of the Spark.

citation.text: "Davriel Cane". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: A planeswalker who fought alongside Ajani in the Seedcore.

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: A devilish planeswalker who created a Doomskar.
